note: Bluestem Point area of El Dorado State Park (KDWP) on the east shore of El Dorado Lake, with the park's cabins: full-hookup Sunflower Meadow (pinned), water/electric Big Pine, Fishermans Point and Quail Run, and primitive Goose Cove, Box Turtle Point and Satchel Creek Cove along the shore to the northeast. Walnut River below the dam and Boulder Bluff on the north shore are their own entries. --Claude
summary: Confirmed lakefront; hookups now 50/water/sewer; sites 500 -> 386 (the seven Bluestem loops in campitks; 279 pull-through, 100 ft); year-round; booking in the 2095 shape; add leads Shady Creek and Bemis Creek.
flags: WATERFRONT: LAKEFRONT kept. Fishermans Point tip sites FP269-FP273 sit 20-45 m from the shore across open mowed grass with only scattered trees; Big Pine's point sites BP472/BP475 sit 40-55 m from the beach edge across open grass (Esri imagery 2026-11-06 with campitks coordinates, zoom ~4 px/m). The primitive shore loops (Goose Cove, Box Turtle, Satchel Creek) also line the shoreline but were not judged site by site.

SITES: 500 -> 386. The stored 500 was KDWP's Bluestem count (70 full + 197 W/E + 233 primitive). campitks lists 70 full and 197 W/E exactly, but only 119 primitive in the numbered Bluestem loops; the rest of KDWP's 233 is unaccounted for (campitks has 75 primitive on the south shore, which matches KDWP's Shady Creek count of 71 instead). The note's 'nine campgrounds' claim is dropped: campitks numbers seven loops.

PIN 37.8553,-96.7762 is ~236 m from the utility-site centroid 37.85741,-96.77592 (on Sunflower Meadow); fine. The all-sites centroid (37.86083,-96.77290) is pulled ~680 m northeast by the primitive shore loops.
